purpose: Paired genuine Bazel 9.3.0 vs native bazel-rs capture of N46 (docs/IMPLICIT_OUTPUTS.md): rule(outputs = ...) dict templates (%{attr} substitution for string/list/label/output/built-in attributes, dirname/basename, type and placeholder errors, configurable placeholders), the function form (parameters, return casts, fail, multi-valued templates), output file targets (build/query by label, default files order: implicit before explicit), ctx.outputs repr/dir and duplicate-key/executable errors, a rules_cc cc_binary-shaped executable rule, package conflict texts, and genuine-Bazel crashes. Workspace tests/fixtures/implicit_outputs/workspace. Evidence only; no test reads it.

native.flags: --ignore_all_rc_files --cache-dir=<private> (no registry needed: the workspace has no dependencies)
